title: Add environment and command-line layers to the config loader
prompt: The config loader (`createConfig`) merges built-in defaults with a JSON config file. Add two more layers as described in README.md ("To add"): environment variables and command-line arguments, with the precedence defaults < file < env < command line, plus `config.explain(path)` which tells where a value came from. Existing behaviour (defaults, file, `get`, errors) must keep working. Run the tests with `npm test`.
